description_html:
Key Features

  • Fumarole-Fed Steeping Mechanism: Utilizes a fumarole-fed system for consistent and efficient steeping, ensuring optimal extraction of flavors and aromas.
  • Precision Brew Temperature: Maintains a stable brewing temperature of 74°C, ideal for extracting delicate notes from tea or coffee without scorching.
  • Single Batch Capacity: Brews up to 593 millilitres per batch, suitable for personal servings or small gatherings.
  • Accurate Extraction Timing: Offers a precise extraction time of 409 seconds, supporting repeatable brewing results for quality and taste consistency.
  • Lightweight Construction: Weighs only 493 grams, making it easy to handle, move, and store as needed.
  • Mains Powered: Operates using a standard mains power source for reliable, uninterrupted brewing sessions.

Main Benefits

  • Consistent Flavor Extraction: The controlled steeping process and temperature regulation help users achieve professional-quality beverages with every use.
  • User-Friendly Operation: Lightweight design and straightforward brewing process make this urn accessible for both beginners and experienced users.
  • Time and Energy Efficient: Fast extraction time and mains-powered operation ensure quick preparation and continuous use without frequent recharging or waiting periods.
  • Space-Saving and Portable: Compact and light, this urn fits easily in kitchens, offices, or event spaces, supporting flexible brewing locations.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Home and Office Brewing: Ideal for individuals seeking a reliable solution for making high-quality tea or coffee at home or in the workplace.
  • Small Gatherings and Events: Suitable for serving fresh beverages at meetings, workshops, or small social events.
  • Consistent Daily Use: Designed for users who prioritize consistency in taste and temperature, making it perfect for daily routines.
  • Easy Maintenance and Storage: The lightweight and compact design supports hassle-free cleaning and storage between uses.

Common User Questions Addressed

  • Is it easy to use? Yes, the lightweight build and simple operation make it accessible for all skill levels.
  • How much can it brew at once? It can steep up to 593ml per batch, ideal for single servings or sharing.
  • Is the temperature adjustable? The unit is optimized for a stable 74°C brew, providing consistent results for most tea and coffee types.
  • What power source does it require? This urn is mains powered for continuous, reliable operation.
  • Is it durable and portable? With a body mass of 493 grams, it is easy to move and designed for regular use in various environments.
